name: Python Development Tools
description: Installs Python development tools: uv, Poetry, ruff, and mypy.

install.description: Comma-separated list of tools to install (e.g. 'uv,ruff'). When set, only the listed tools are installed. When empty (default), all tools are installed.

omit.description: Comma-separated list of tools to exclude (e.g. 'mypy'). When set, the listed tools are skipped. Applied after 'install' filtering.

poetryVersion.description: Version of Poetry to install, or 'latest'

inProjectVenvs.description: Configure Poetry to create virtualenvs in project directory
